title: Title and epigraph
story_beat: Time for Dinner Productions presents The Titanic Club. Everyone screaming in the bus.
animation_idea: Bus judders across the hills, AHHHH text pulses

title: Meet the spuds
story_beat: Stick-figure Callum asks to be drawn as he is; magic turns him, then everyone, into potatoes.
animation_idea: Sparkle wipe from stick figure to potato; cast pops in one by one
stress_meters: Meters appear for the first time

title: Through the storm cloud
story_beat: The plane hurtles through a storm. The Titanic Club keep cool; the broad bean lady does not. Then life-affirming turbulence.
animation_idea: Plane shakes, lightning flashes; planes bounce on springs
stress_meters: Broad bean guest meter maxes out

title: Le Taxi at Lyon
story_beat: A dark, closed airport and rough taxi drivers. Which taxi do we get?
animation_idea: Drivers lean in; plane flies over

title: Uber! and Le Hotel
story_beat: Tash summons two Ubers. Burgers, pizza, bunk beds, and a scolding for pinball at 1am.
animation_idea: Two cars drive off in opposite moods; pinball ball bounces
sound_idea: Oui oui / non non; pinball dings

title: The patisserie
story_beat: A gentle snooze, then sensational pastries. You mean they eat the flutes here?
animation_idea: Pastries fly around the spud

title: The centre of the road
story_beat: The first Uber drops some of the club in the middle of the road. RUUUN like adrenaline-soaked chickens.
animation_idea: Chicken-spuds scurry across the screen

title: Rhianna picks the train station
story_beat: Asked "original destination, or for no reason whatsoever, the Lyon train station?", Ranna chose the train station.
animation_idea: Car zooms past the car hire; Wait, STOP!

title: Held hostage at the car hire
story_beat: Annelisa and Enda go up the lift and vanish. Are they being held hostage?
animation_idea: Clock hands spin; lift doors

title: VROOOOM then BAAM
story_beat: The car is booked, Enda hits the accelerator, and promptly crashes into the car park barrier.
animation_idea: Minibus lurches forward and hits the barrier, screen shakes

title: Today's driving forecast
story_beat: The forecast dial: Easy, Tough... French.
animation_idea: Needle swings to French

title: The wing mirror
story_beat: A local going about their day nearly loses their head to the wing mirror. Enda forgot the width of the new vehicle.
animation_idea: Mirror sweeps past the local's head

title: Full crisis control
story_beat: Joe froze and hoped everything would pan out. Meanwhile, Enda focused on the road ahead.
animation_idea: Joe trembles; Enda bobs to music notes

title: Drive on the RIGHT, Enda
images: IMG-037 IMG-038 IMG-039 IMG-040 IMG-041 IMG-042 IMG-043 IMG-044 IMG-045
story_beat: One hour later: French number plates, a random tyre, back-seat drivers, a roundabout full of HONKs and a minibus that always stalls in first gear.
animation_idea: Tyre flies in; cars circle the roundabout

title: The Navigation Award
story_beat: Annelisa wins the 2022 Navigation Award, just before the lane with the skull sign and the fire.
animation_idea: Award trophy spins, then the skull sign wobbles

title: Le danger on the motorway
story_beat: A driver cuts in front of the minibus. Joe squeezes his bag so hard he leaves claw marks. Meanwhile, Enda was totally fine.
animation_idea: Faces stretch in terror; bag gets claw marks

title: FLOOR IT!
story_beat: One hour without incident... then nuclear towers and a log truck. After a Final Destination 2 comparison, Enda accelerated to safety.
animation_idea: Logs wobble on the truck; minibus overtakes

title: The toll booth
story_beat: DON'T lose the ticket. Oh, shit. Rhianna is reading for her life. Random HGV convoys in the villages.
animation_idea: Ticket flutters away; HGVs rumble past

title: We'll all get DVT!
story_beat: Long drive, no services for 100,000 m. I'm like a frog in boiling water. Meanwhile, Enda was totally fine.
animation_idea: Frog bubbles in the pot

title: Speaking French-ish
story_beat: Un pizza plz? WHAT?! Five minutes later: a hillside on fire. OMG.
animation_idea: Flames flicker on the hill

title: Le Satnav takes the adventurous route
story_beat: The satnav recalculates and sends the Titanic Club the wrong way up a single-track mountain, towards the forest fire.
animation_idea: Route line redraws itself; satnav smiles
stress_meters: Max for all; Enda sweating but "totally fine"

title: Is that Le Mazel?
story_beat: A ruin: the fire got to it before we did. A random exclamation sign. No lay-bys, only ditches that lead off a cliff.
animation_idea: Exclamation sign pops; minibus inches along the edge

title: Made it to Le Mazel
story_beat: After 4.5 hours of near-misses, the Titanic Club made it. Happy Anniversary honey...
animation_idea: Scorched minibus rolls in; happy sun

title: FIN
story_beat: Fin, in the colours of the French flag.
animation_idea: Flag ripples

title: Afterword
story_beat: Rosie & Joe explain the name and that every line is a real WhatsApp quote. P.S. quotes from the trip home. Bonus quote.
animation_idea: Scrolling credits
